copy.bizOwner: The details above are fictional development values. Real entity, licence and eligibility documents have not been supplied.
copy.bizLicence: The number and issuer below are sample text, not a licence or proof of eligibility.
copy.bizNotice: No real notification link is configured. Filing and confirmation are pre-launch tasks.
copy.privacyPurpose: The age-gate declaration is checked on the server; the name and date of birth are not written to the database, cookies, application logs or analytics. The shop makes no analytics or third-party embed calls.
copy.privacyFlows: The age marker cookie contains a fixed value. The cart cookie contains only vintage identifiers and quantities. The checkout cookie contains only a random server-draft handle, not personal information. A draft can contain buyer, recipient and message details; a placed order stores a snapshot of transaction and contact details.
copy.privacyRetention: A checkout draft becomes unavailable when placed, after an under-age refusal, or when it expires. The shop never deletes orders. The period for a micro business is pending legal review.
copy.privacyAccess: Order and draft data are not publicly available through the API; administrators can access them. The application does not log personal data.
copy.privacyRights: To request access, correction or help with personal data, contact the email in the footer. Request verification and response times need confirmation before launch.
copy.privacyPending: The server-side draft may hold buyer information before consent at the review step, for up to the period shown below. Its notice and legal basis are pending legal review.
copy.termsParties: A buyer may continue only after declaring an age at or above the threshold shown below. The shop currently asks for name, date of birth, phone, email and residential address; the date of birth is checked but not stored. Business details on the business information page are samples.
copy.termsOrder: An order is created only after the buyer reviews the goods, quantities, delivery method and time, amounts and payment method, then ticks consent to the terms and privacy policy. The server recalculates prices, stock and fees at placement.
copy.termsDelivery: The courier hands wine only to an eligible adult who shows ID. A gift is delivered to its recipient; without ID it is not handed over. What happens after a failed ID check is pending legal review.
copy.termsPayment: An unpaid order holds stock for {minutes} minutes after placement; after that it expires and stock is released. Only the simulated choices listed below exist; there is no cash on delivery, real payment gateway, or request for a card/account number. The shop does not delete orders. The period for a micro business is pending review.
copy.termsPending: Guest buyers receive a private order-status link without an account. Whether this meets the requirement for order details to remain accessible in the buyer's account is pending legal review.
copy.complaintChannel: Send complaints to the contact email shown in the footer.
copy.complaintTimeline: Draft target: acknowledge receipt within 3 business days and update the proposed handling within 10 business days. The owner must confirm these targets before launch; no intake system or automated email currently exists.
copy.complaintScope: Include the order number if available, the item, the issue and a way to contact you. Do not send card numbers, account numbers or date of birth.
copy.priceDisplay: Product and packaging prices are shown in VND, including VAT under the current calculation. Delivery fees are shown separately before order confirmation.
copy.wrapPaid: Gift wrapping is a paid service per order; units are calculated from bottle count and package capacity. There is no free tier.
copy.noOtherFee: Apart from goods, selected packaging and the delivery fee for the chosen area, the current order flow adds no other amount to the total.
copy.ageLimit: Only a visitor who declares and is checked as meeting the age threshold shown below can continue through the gate and place an order. This is self-declaration; there is no eKYC.
copy.geoLimit: The system currently has only the delivery areas listed below. This is a configured delivery limit, not a statement of the legal scope of a licence; geographic scope is pending review.
copy.stockRule: Only published items with stock can be added to the cart; stock and prices are checked again at order placement.
copy.paymentMethods: An unpaid order holds stock for {minutes} minutes after placement; after that it expires and stock is released. Only the listed cashless methods are available. Both are simulations here: no money is sent and there is no COD.
copy.refundMethod: There is no real payment or refund function in the application. The draft proposal is to refund through the original payment channel if real payments are added; method and timing need confirmation before launch.
copy.paymentSecurity: No card or bank account number is collected. The order stores only the simulated method name and payment status.
copy.shippingMethod: Orders are designed for home delivery within the configured areas. No carrier or delivery service is integrated.
copy.deliveryAge: The buyer receiving an order must meet the age threshold and show ID. For gifts, the recipient must also meet it and show ID; otherwise the courier does not hand over the order.
copy.inspection: The application has no integrated inspection or receipt record. Contact the footer email if delivered goods do not match the listing; the physical inspection process needs confirmation before launch.
copy.returnMismatch: If received goods do not match the listing, contact the footer email. Mismatched goods are to be taken back; collection and verification procedures need confirmation before launch.
copy.returnRequest: Send the order number, describe the mismatch and provide contact details. There is no return form, carrier, request deadline or automated process yet.
copy.returnRefund: There are no real transactions, so the application does not issue refunds. If real payments are added, the draft proposal is to refund through the original payment channel; terms and timing need confirmation.
copy.failedId: If the recipient does not show ID, an administrator can set the order status to delivery failed. The code does not automatically cancel the order, refund it, restock it or decide who pays a fee; that handling is pending legal review.
